Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only

# input marker coords from demo2, evaluate 4-connected empty components
from collections import deque
n=16
marks2=[(0,7),(1,6),(2,5),(3,4),(4,3),(5,2),(6,1),(7,0),
(1,14),(2,13),(3,12),(4,11),(5,10),(6,9),(7,8),(8,7),
(9,6),(9,15),(10,9),(10,14),(11,8),(11,13),(12,7),(12,12),(13,6),(13,11),(14,5),(15,4)]
# labels empty 4-neighbor; border-connected
seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(n):
 for c in range(n):
  if (r,c) in marks2 or (r,c) in seen: continue
  q=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
  while q:
   x,y=q.pop(); comp.append((x,y))
   for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
    a,b=x+dx,y+dy
    if 0<=a<n and 0<=b<n and (a,b) not in marks2 and (a,b) not in seen:
     seen.add((a,b));q.append((a,b))
  comps.append(comp)
[(len(x), any(r in [0,15] or c in [0,15] for r,c in x), (min(r for r,c in x),max(r for r,c in x), min(c for r,c in x),max(c for r,c in x))) for x in comps if not any(r in [0,15] or c in [0,15] for r,c in x)]
